Name: Combat Item Obtainability
Author: Cheerybelle
Description:
The primary mod adds six existing items to the Adventurer's Guild:
[font=Verdana]- [size=1]The[/size] Rapier                [size=1]can be purchased for[/size] 5500g [size=1]after reaching[/size] Floor 70 [size=1]of the[/size] Mines.
- [size=1]The[/size] Cowboy Boots     [size=1]can be purchased for[/size] 1500g [size=1]after reaching[/size] Floor 60 [size=1]of the[/size] Mines.
- [size=1]The[/size] Steel Smallsword [size=1]can be purchased for [/size]500g [size=1]after reaching[/size] Floor 20 [size=1]of the[/size] Mines.
- [size=1]The[/size] Elf Blade             [size=1]can be purchased for [/size]800g [size=1]after reaching[/size] Floor 20 [size=1]of the[/size] Mines.
- [size=1]The[/size] Crystal Dagger     [size=1]can be purchased for[/size] 5000g [size=1]after reaching[/size] Floor 60 [size=1]of the[/size] Mines.
- [size=1]The[/size] Obsidian Edge      [size=1]can be purchased for[/size] 7000g [size=1]after reaching[/size] Floor 90 [size=1]of the[/size] Mines.[/font]

The Femur and the Galaxy Slingshot have their own, separate included mods.
[color=#d9d2e9]- The Galaxy Slingshot can be purchased from the Adventurer's Guild for double the price of the Gold Clock after obtaining 100 Golden Walnuts.[/color]
The Femur currently has two options [size=1](You can use both simultaneously)[/size]:
[color=#fce5cd]- The "Buy" version allows the Femur to be purchased from the Adventurer's Guild for 350g after reaching Floor 10 of the Mines.[/color]
[color=#fce5cd]- The "Mine Node" version requires [/color][color=#e69138][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions[/url]﻿[/u][/color][color=#fce5cd] and adds bone piles that each drop a Femur and can rarely replace rocks in the Mines on Floors 10-30. You won't encounter one every time you go through the relevant floors of the Mines, but it's not exceedingly rare, either.[/color]

Details about these items' vanilla obtainability:
[color=#d8d8d8]- The Rapier, Cowboy Boots, and Galaxy Slingshot are normally unobtainable.[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]- The Steel Smallsword, Crystal Dagger, and Obsidian Edge are normally only obtainable from milestone chests in the Mines and are often unobtainable with Remixed Mines Rewards enabled.[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]- The Elf Blade and Femur normally only have a chance to be obtainable from milestone chests in the Mines with Remixed Mines Rewards enabled.[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]- Normally, you cannot obtain the Steel Smallsword and the Elf Blade in the same playthrough, as they are both assigned to the Floor 20 chest.[/color]

Notes on items not included:
[color=#d8d8d8]- All footwear obtained from Mines milestone chests have alternative sources (mostly as fishing treasure loot).[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]- Most previously-unobtainable weapons have been made obtainable across the past few major updates.[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]- There is a certain pair of blue boots obtainable from a certain event that is one-of-a-kind, much like most of the items covered in this mod. Due to the nature of the event that it comes from, however, I decided to not address its obtainability in this mod. I may make other mods to cover other special one-off items like that in the future, but don't hold your breath on that.[/color]

Extra notes about the mod:
[color=#d8d8d8]- The floors that the items unlock at are based on when they would normally be obtained (for the Mines reward items) or based on their stats (for the normally unobtainable items).[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]- Costs are based on the relative stats of the weapons compared to the costs and stats of the existing items in the shop.[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]- The bone pile (femur node) from the Femur (Mines Node) module has a spawn frequency of 0.182%, meaning that roughly one in every 550 rocks will be replaced with a bone pile.[/color]

Behind the scenes:
[color=#d8d8d8]- I had more ideas for options for Femur obtainability, but it dropping from Skeletons felt kind of pointless given the low stats, and I couldn't figure out how to add an entry to the Mines special item drop pools, so I settled on just the Buy and Node options.
- The reason why the Femur got special treatment is because the Adventurer's Guild selling grimy, old human bones seems like it would be uncharacteristic of them. ...I always assumed it was a human femur, anyway. It doesn't actually specify.
- I wanted to spend more time refining the spawn rates and sprite for the bone pile, but, after enough hours of tweaking numbers and colors and doing repeated tests on the spawn rates, I had to just put my hands up and get the mod out the door. If the sprite looks too out of place and/or bone piles appear too frequently/rarely, I'm sorry. I tried. I'm only me.[/color]

Notes about old versions of the mod:
[color=#d8d8d8]- Release 1: "The Rusty Sword (normally one-of-a-kind) can be purchased for 100g (in case you dispose of the original)."
This was removed in Release 2 due to the feature being added to the vanilla game (albeit at a different price).[/color]
